Progression guide

From your first catch to endgame: what to aim for, and when.

Day 1First weekMid gameEndgameMore guides

Four stages, each with a goal, a short checklist and the sign you're ready for the next one. Every number comes from the game. Tap a link for the full page.

  1. 1Day 1

    Starter to your first Gym badge. Jump

  2. 2First week

    Badges 1 and 2: a real squad, eggs and steady balls. Jump

  3. 3Mid game

    Badges 3 to 7: islands, look breeding, raids, the Tower and guilds. Jump

  4. 4Endgame

    All 8 badges: rare looks, the Mythic Shop, Glimmer and events. Jump

Day 1Goal: your first Gym badge

  1. 1Starter, then upgrades

    Pick any of the 27 starters, then spend early money on Sweet Scent and the Catching Charm. Upgrades

  2. 2Check Catch rules

    Auto-restock tops Poké Balls back up to 20 after every battle. New species and every special look are caught by default. Catch rules

  3. 3Fill your Day Care pen

    Two of the same family lay twice as fast. Day Care

  4. 4Bosses, then the Gym

    Beat 6 bosses on Dewleaf Town to open Matt's Gym. Gyms

Unlocked by
Starting the game
Unlocks
Rush charges, Sunny Shore and more balls and held items at the Mart
Ready to move on when
You hold your first badge and your pen is laying eggs

Common mistakes: grinding at the level cap (the next Gym's ace + 3): bring better type matchups or Power-ups instead. Running out of balls: a rare find with no ball runs away.

First weekGoal: badges 1 and 2, and a team that wins on its own

  1. 1Build a squad

    4 Pokémon: a DPS lead, a Break and a Support. Teach one False Swipe or a sleep move to make it your Catcher. Squads

  2. 2Keep eggs coming

    Pen 2 opens at 2 badges. Pair the same family, a shared type, or Ditto. Day Care

  3. 3Raise auto-restock

    Set Ultra Ball restock once Ace Trainer rank puts them in the Mart. Catch rules

  4. 4Climb your rank

    New species raise your Trainer rank: better look odds. Clear Daily research too.

Unlocked by
Your first badge
Unlocks
Wonder Trade and Day Care pen 2 at 2 badges
Ready to move on when
You have 2 badges, all three roles in your squad and eggs hatching

Common mistakes: a squad of only DPS loses Shatter and Guarded. A pen pair with no shared family or type (or two Ditto) never lays.

Mid gameGoal: all 8 badges, and your first hunts for looks

  1. 1Push the islands

    Each Gym opens the next island. Wild legendaries wake on beaten islands once you hold 3 badges. Islands

  2. 2Breed for looks

    Parents from different islands double the base look odds, and a parent with a look adds its own. Try the Breeding calculator.

  3. 3Raids and the Tower

    Raids from your 5th badge: a new 5★ boss every 12 hours (a Mythical from 00:00 UTC, a Legendary from 12:00 UTC). The Battle Tower from your 3rd: one PC Pokémon starts over at Lv 5.

  4. 4Community and guilds

    The Community tab holds Friends, the live feed of rare finds and your guild. Join or found one at 3 badges. Friends

Unlocked by
Your 3rd badge
Unlocks
Mass Outbreaks, the Night Market and guilds at 3 badges · Raids at 5 badges · the Poké Radar at 6 badges
Ready to move on when
You hold all 8 badges: the level cap is gone

Common mistakes: breeding two parents from the same island halves your look odds. Founding a guild costs $1,000,000: joining one is free.

EndgameGoal: rare looks, your collection and a weekly routine

  1. 1Chase rare looks

    Void, Prismatic, Gilded, Mirage and more. The Safari Zone (600 steps a day) and the Prism Altar open with all 8 badges. Special looks

  2. 2Earn Glimmer

    Your specials and Night Market sales pay Glimmer: buy rare finds, the Glimmer Shop and extra Raid Passes. Glimmer

  3. 3Mythic Shop

    Events → Style: 5 animated looks a week, new every Monday 00:00 UTC. What you buy stays yours. Style

  4. 4Events and Card Rush

    Check the Events calendar. Card Rush: Sundays for 8 hours, up to 3 species come with their Full Art card 1 in 10. Events

Unlocked by
Your 8th badge
Unlocks
The Safari Zone, the Prism Altar, 3 outbreaks at a time and no level cap
There's no last step
Fill the Stamp book and Achievements

Common mistakes: selling on the Night Market opens 2 days after you start playing online, so plan early. Card Rush odds only cover its featured species while it runs (after that, 1 in 20).
